bitcoin_accepted_here_stickers: Stickers na 'Ana Karɓar Bitcoin a Nan'
biz_stickers_hero_subtitle: Faɗa wa abokan cinikinka kana karɓar Bitcoin. Yi oda fakitin kyauta na labaru “Bitcoin Accepted Here” don sa a kasuwancinka.
biz_stickers_intro_c1: Karɓar Bitcoin rabin aiki ne — abokan cinikinka suna buƙatar sani shi ma. An ƙera ƙananan labaru “Bitcoin Accepted Here” don sa a ƙofar gaba, a wurin sayarwa, a kan menu ko ko'ina abokan cinikinka za su gan su kafin su biya.
biz_stickers_intro_c2: Za mu aika fakiti kyauta zuwa kowane adireshi a Amurka ko Kanada, ko za ka iya buga naka ko'ina a duniya.
biz_stickers_step_description: Muna aika fakitoci kyauta zuwa adireshin a Amurka da Kanada. Ko'ina kuma a duniya, za ka iya buga naka.
biz_stickers_option_print: 🌍 A duk faɗin duniya — buga naka
biz_stickers_print_c1: Za ka iya buga labaranka na “Bitcoin Accepted Here” ko'ina kake. Danna harshenka a ƙasa don saukar da fayilolin labaru da umarnin bugawa.
biz_stickers_request_c1: Cika fom ɗin da ke ƙasa don neman fayilolin labaru “Bitcoin Accepted Here” a cikin harshenka na cikin gida. Za mu sanar da kai da zarar sun shirya.
biz_stickers_placeholder_translation2: Fassara “Scan to learn why Bitcoin is good for business.”
